rationale: The change modifies the interface supplying obstacle information to the Observable Representation, while the Evaluation Target, Phenomenon of Interest, object-category scheme, and ego-object spatial relation remain unchanged. In the baseline, H1-ORR1 depends on H1-A1 and revalidation condition H1-RC1, which explicitly requires revalidation if the obstacle-detection requirements, architectural responsibility for obstacle information, or the information supplied for representing obstacle presence changes. This change matches that dependency. H1-ORR2 and H1-ORR3 are not affected because the object-category scheme and ego-object spatial relation are stated to remain unchanged.
